text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Jingle bells, jingle bells...♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Christmas has always been pretty modest 
for me up until now. But still...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Modest as it was, it was fun. The little 
ones were happy, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (But this year...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (This is hell. Hahaha... absolute hell...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ngggggh... Can't... eat... Not another... 
single bite... Guhh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days before Christmas. As if 
crushed by the mounting pressure, Tamamo 
Cross completely lost her appetite.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Why... Why, we were so close...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Eat it up, body of mine... Just a little 
more, just...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's training or racing, you can't 
get anywhere with zero passion. Tamamo 
Cross was pushed that far into a corner.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I don't eat, I can't push myself to the 
limit. And if I can't push myself, I can't 
beat her...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just lemme go all out against that guy at 
the end! That's all I'm askin' for!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I'm sorry for this pathetic 
body of mine... I have to... I have to do 
something about this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was obvious that I couldn't do 
anything on my own. On the contrary, the 
growing frustration chipped away at my 
appetite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If things go on like this, she'll lose 
without ever showing her true strength, 
and that will be etched into history as 
her final race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I decided to act not just as a Trainer, 
but as Tamamo Cross's partner."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tama-chan's Trainer. Is there 
something you need~?
choice_data_list: There's something I want to ask.
There's something I want to ask.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
My, my~ Tracking down one of my 
hideouts... I'm impressed.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Now, who were you again? What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-dong, ding-dong!)
Coming, who might it be...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Mother
text_block_list.text: A-Are you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I ran around to every single place I 
could think of. And then—it was Christmas 
Day."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion, Trainer... Though... 
I'm really not in the mood for a party 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"No one can give me the thing I really 
want as a present. Besides..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't even wanna look at cake or chicken 
right now. Just let me rest...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Geh, what's this? This food doesn't feel 
like Christmas at all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's just a normal set meal, isn't it? No 
fancy decorations or anything...
choice_data_list:
Give it a try. Just as much as you can 
manage.

Give it a try. Just as much as you can 
manage.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Even if ya say 'all I can eat,' I can 
really only manage a single bite. Ya know 
that, right?"
choice_data_list: Then just take a single bite, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sincerity, informational capability, and 
analytical skills are all being tested. At 
this world's most plain Christmas dinner.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I see. Well, don't mind if I do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross took a bite, and...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What's this...? I can't quite tell. It 
feels nostalgic... ...yet a bit 
different... But still..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
......Delicious. My body isn't rejecting 
it at all. In fact, this...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wanna eat it. Smells so good... What is 
this? What on earth is this...
choice_data_list: Great, then go ahead and eat...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! Yeah, don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*Nom nom, munch munch, gobble gobble...!* 
What in the world is this, what is it...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked into everything. Tamamo Cross's 
preferences, nutritional science, and 
current physical condition. From every 
single angle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The culmination of that effort: a single, 
ultimate dish. If this can just reach the 
bottom of her stomach, maybe—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...In the gut...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"It soaked right into... my belly... That 
meal felt like it nourished my very 
soul..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How can you make something like this? A 
meal made with love... thinking of someone 
from the bottom of your heart...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You... you know all of it, don't you...? 
My mother's cooking, what I like, what I 
need... all of it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why you're giving me such a 
Christmas meal...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, I told ya one lie earlier. 
Remember how I said there wasn't any 
present I wanted?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That was a lie. I... figured it out...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is what I wanted. Something to hold 
on to, right at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... "Hunger" is definitely my 
strength. But... but still...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I starve completely, I won't survive! 
Even for me! But right now...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If ya ain't hungry, ya can't win... That's 
why I throw myself into the deep end, so 
far that even my family's warmth can't 
reach...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the dark. Nothin's reachin' me. 
Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This food... your feelings reached me... 
Even to someone like me, who closed myself 
off and threw it all away... it gave me 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Through this food... I can see them. You 
and your family, watching over me from the 
other side.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just a wee bit's fine, it's plenty. In the 
midst of starvation... if there's just a 
single ray of light...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I can run it through to the end! I'll 
survive the time remaining until the Arima 
Kinen with everything I've got...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt it clearly. That the final ray of 
light had reached Tamamo Cross, suffering 
at rock bottom.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's only a few days left. 
Cook for me during these few days, will 
ya?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
With this momentum, as long as you've got 
my back all the way, we can definitely do 
this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross—can become a lightning bolt 
faster than Oguri Cap! That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The white powder snow falling from the sky 
celebrates the revival of the White 
Lightning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A lightning strike. The bolt meant to 
strike down halted just in time on this 
day... and like an ascending dragon, began 
to climb back up into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A lightning strike. The bolt meant to 
strike down halted just in time on this 
day... and like an ascending dragon, began 
to climb back up into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, after eating, taking a walk to 
help digest the food is pretty nice too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wanna take a bit of a walk? The city's all 
sparklin' and shiny, too.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Tamamo Cross. Tamamo Croooss!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Merry Christmas, everyone! Thanks 
for all your support!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Who's that next to you~? Woo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what, quit talking nonsense! It's not 
like that at all. This guy is my tr...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Not that that's necessarily the case, 
either...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You're not just a trainer anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross gave a mischievous grin and 
said,

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This here is my family! My dad, my mom, 
and the lil' ones all know 'em!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Tell your friends! That Tamamo Cross had 
one more member in her family!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Someone who knows this much about me 
is basically family already.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, can it? That's just how 
it turned out. In the first place, you're 
getting way too involved.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's head home. We can warm up 
under the kotatsu once we're back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross found a new home at Tracen 
Academy. And that warmth, too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was about to become a new source of 
strength for Tamamo Cross.
